dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 05, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Mets Walk-Off Victory in Thrilling 10-9 Win Over Braves**

In a back-and-forth game that saw 19 runs scored, the New York Mets edged out the Atlanta Braves 10-9 in extra innings. Juan Soto and Bo Bichette each had a big day at the plate, but Drake Baldwin stole the show with a 2-HR, 4-RBI performance. On the mound, Nolan McLean earned the win with 6 strong innings of work, striking out 5 and allowing just 2 earned runs. The Mets' bullpen held on to secure the win, with Devin Williams earning his 10th save of the season.

**Pirates Blast Nationals 11-5**

Meanwhile, the Pittsburgh Pirates notched an 11-5 victory over the Washington Nationals. Brandon Lowe led the way with a 1-HR, 3-RBI day, while Konnor Griffin and Bryan Reynolds also contributed with strong performances. Eddy Yean earned a scoreless 2-inning outing, striking out 3 in the process. The Pirates' offense exploded for 11 runs, with 4 players notching multi-hit games.

**Twins Shut Down Yankees 6-1**

The Minnesota Twins continued their hot streak with a 6-1 win over the New York Yankees. Royce Lewis and Austin Martin each had 2-hit games, while Brooks Lee chipped in with 2 RBIs. Joe Ryan was dominant on the mound, fanning 9 over 7 strong innings to earn the win.
